weightPotential.rationale: Heavy-lipid core: Butyrospermum Parkii Butter @7, Cocos Nucifera Oil @8 — ranked above every tail-class species and above the formula's own sole cationic @12, so the core is read on ordinal merits rather than solely on the (unresolved) marker. Completers both present: cetearyl-class Cetearyl Alcohol @3 (top three) and an occlusive Dimethicone @4 + Dimethiconol @5 pair. → high; confidence capped at moderate by the unresolved marker; review.

repairSupportLevel.rationale: No protein/peptide route and no bond token; silicones and oils are explicit non-upgraders. Capped at moderate by the unresolved marker.

primaryFocus.rationale: Steps 3–5 clear nothing (no R5/bond; humectants above any boundary: Glycerin @2 only — Diglycerin @13 not on the R9 list; shine criterion 1 fails because R4b is present). Step 6 smoothing: architecture extends materially beyond the base via a distinct Dimethicone @4 / Dimethiconol @5 silicone system; 'Smooth Anti-Frizz' positioning corroborates. focus_care_verdict: not_applicable.
